landing.heroDesc: Decentralisé bolomafaraw ka sɛrɛkiliw Stellar kan. Zero cɛmancɛlamɔgɔw. Nafolo yɛrɛmahɔrɔnya ka ɲɛsin mɔgɔ miliyari 1,3 ma min tɛ banki la.
landing.howItWorks: A bɛ baara kɛ cogo min na
landing.architectureTitle: Architecture de la confiance (daɲɛgafe) ka baarakɛcogo
landing.feat1Desc: Kontra hakilitigiw bɛ sariya bɛɛ labato. Labɛnbaga si tɛ se ka boli ni jidagayɔrɔ ye. Bolomafara bɛɛ sɛgɛsɛgɛra cakɛda kan.
landing.feat2Desc: Mɔgɔ o mɔgɔ bɛ ni Stellar waribɔlan ye. Banki jatebɔsɛbɛn tɛ yen. Krediti sɛgɛsɛgɛli tɛ kɛ. Dan tɛ yen.
landing.feat3Desc: Aw ye aw ka MoiScore jɔ ni bolomafara bɛɛ ye waati kɔnɔ. Nafolo dɔnniya min bɛ se ka ta ka taa yɔrɔ bɛɛ.
landing.feat4Desc: Stellar sub-cent transactions bɛ don o don sɛrɛkiliw kɛ fɛn ye min bɛ se ka kɛ. Plateforme sara si tɛ kɛ ka dabɔ walima ka fara a kan.
landing.feat5Title: Sariya minnu bɛ se ka wuli ka bɔ u nɔ na
landing.feat5Desc: Kɔrɔlen, fixe, sannifeere, walima wote. Aw ka sɛrɛkili, aw ka sariyaw.
landing.feat6Desc: USDC bi. Stablecoins caman wɛrɛw bɛ sirako kan.

landing.readyDesc: Aw ye aw ka bolomafara sɛrɛkili fɔlɔ da miniti fila jukɔrɔ.
